Leave management system for plant owners with shift workers: the morning shift starts and the line is short. Again. The leave was asked for, in a text or out loud at the gate, and nobody wrote it down. So the morning goes on moving people around, and at month-end payroll is left guessing who was off.

FineHR by Fine Solves keeps leave, attendance and payroll in one system. Leave is asked for and approved in FineHR, so you see who is off before the shift starts, not after. And the same leave days are already there when payroll runs.
